summary: DeepSeek announced general availability of DeepSeek-V4-Pro with agent-focused upgrades, flexible reasoning effort levels, native OpenAI Responses API support, and a new peak/off-peak API pricing structure effective August 16, 2026.

practices.reason: The lab claims strong production gains in agent workflows and introduces tiered reasoning effort levels, but offers no benchmark or metric to verify the gain, so it merits investigation before depending on it.
practices.quote: 🔷 Major Agent upgrades with strong production gains! 🔷 Flexible reasoning effort for V4-Pro & V4-Flash: low for simple tasks, high for daily Agent workflows, max for complex tasks.

practices.reason: Teams integrating with DeepSeek can now use the standard OpenAI Responses API with one-click Codex setup, changing how the API is wired into existing tooling.
practices.quote: Native OpenAI Responses API support, optimized for Codex with one-click setup.

practices.reason: A dated pricing change with peak/off-peak rates requires engineering teams to schedule workloads to capture the off-peak discount before the stated effective time.
practices.quote: New pricing takes effect at 16:00 UTC, Aug 16, 2026
